name: Softblock
description: Two soft bars crossed at right angles, which leaves a square with no corners.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 12%, #000 28% 72%, transparent 88%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 12%, #000 28% 72%, transparent 88%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 12%, #000 28% 72%, transparent 88%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 12%, #000 28% 72%, transparent 88%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
